name: xee-skills
description: Skills that hand your app's subscription work to your agent: add the Xee SDK to an iOS app, move a live app off Adapty or RevenueCat in phases, get the first sandbox purchase through, find out why a purchase does not unlock access, turn a paywall or an onboarding flow into testable values and read test results, and answer a question straight from Xee's docs.

interface.longDescription: Hand your iOS app's in-app purchase work to your agent. Add the Xee SDK and activate it, load a paywall's values from Xee, move a live app off Adapty or RevenueCat in phases, diagnose a sandbox purchase that does not go through or does not unlock access, turn a paywall or an onboarding flow into testable values and read test results, and get answers from Xee's docs. Needs a Xee server and its MCP connected.
